title: Submodular Maximization Approaches for Equitable Client Selection in Federated Learning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical and algorithmic definition of 'fairness' and 'equity' within a Federated Learning framework, specifically regarding how to select clients to ensure consistent model performance across a heterogeneous network. It evaluates these methods using image datasets (MNIST and CIFAR10) and does not engage with religious, moral, or ethical reasoning as defined in the context of faith or social ethics.
